sources.title: Deep Research Max preview
sources.evidence: Exact agent ID; 1,048,576-token input context; text, image, PDF, audio and video inputs; text and image outputs; planning, visualization, MCP and File Search. Page dated April 28, 2026.

sources.title: Deep Research Max: a step change for autonomous research agents
sources.evidence: April 21, 2026 announcement makes Deep Research and Max publicly available that day through paid Gemini API tiers. Names Gemini 3.1 Pro as the model used and describes Max reasoning, searching and report refinement with additional inference compute.

sources.title: Gemini Deep Research agent
sources.evidence: October 13, 2026 guide explicitly lists this Max agent ID. Access is exclusively through Interactions API. Supports reasoning summaries, remote MCP, search, file search and visualizations; custom Function Calling tools are unsupported. Distinguishes an agent workflow from a model.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Gemini API service terms effective March 23, 2026 impose use restrictions and prohibit extracting underlying models or parameter weights; supports proprietary service classification rather than a documentation-content license.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro Model Card
sources.evidence: Identifies the underlying Gemini 3.1 Pro model as based on Gemini 3 Pro and explicitly refers architecture to the Gemini 3 Pro card. Does not give a total or active parameter count for Deep Research Max.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro Model Card (updated May 2026)
sources.evidence: Later card explicitly includes Gemini 3.1 Pro in its family and describes sparse MoE Transformer architecture. It does not identify Deep Research Max as a separately counted checkpoint or disclose its total/active counts.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Model Card (October 2026)
sources.evidence: Later first-party model card and comparison table checked for retrospective disclosure. They do not provide Deep Research Max parameter counts or its complete agent architecture; Argon specifications are not transferred.

sources.title: Build with Gemini Deep Research
sources.evidence: December 11, 2025 announcement covers the earlier Deep Research API agent. The April 2026 announcement introduces Max separately, so this earlier date is not this variant's release.

name.note: Official name with capitalization normalized to the catalog.

developer.note: Google announcement authored by Google DeepMind product/program managers.

family.note: Catalog family normalization reflects the explicitly documented Gemini 3.1 Pro backbone; this identifier is an agent.

release_date.note: Public preview availability began on April 21, 2026. The December 2025 agent is a predecessor.

open_weights.note: Managed agent available exclusively through the Interactions API, with proprietary service terms and no published weight release.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the governed API service; the page-content and code-sample licenses do not license the model weights.

parameters_b.note: No agent-wide total is published in the exact documentation, launch announcement or checked later model cards. This managed workflow is not a separately published checkpoint.

active_parameters_b.note: No per-token active count is disclosed for this agent. Repeated model invocations and extended inference compute are not parameter counts.

architecture.note: No single architecture is specified for the complete agent. Its documented Gemini 3.1 Pro backbone points to a sparse MoE Transformer card, but that does not describe every component of the managed workflow.

context_window.note: Exact Max agent page specifies an input context window of 1,048,576 tokens.

modalities.note: Matches the exact Max agent page; generated images are an agent capability, not evidence that the backbone itself outputs images.

reasoning.note: Max performs iterative reasoning with additional inference compute; agent configuration exposes intermediate reasoning summaries.

tool_call.note: Agent supports built-in tools and remote MCP servers. Custom Function Calling tools are explicitly unsupported, so this boolean denotes agent tool use.

description.value: Managed research agent built with Gemini 3.1 Pro that plans multi-step investigations and produces cited reports with optional visualizations.
description.note: Clarifies that the catalog ID names a managed agent and attributes the underlying model without transferring checkpoint specifications.

Gemini API Additional Terms of Service

patch.notes: Managed agent launched with Gemini 3.1 Pro, whose model card describes a sparse MoE Transformer. That backbone does not describe the entire research and visualization workflow; agent-level parameter counts are not published. Tool support includes remote MCP, but excludes custom function-calling tools.

summary: Confirmed the exact Max agent identifier, April 21 launch, context window and multimodal inputs/outputs. Added proprietary license classification and clarified the agent description and tool-call boundary. Total/active counts remain undisclosed; a single checkpoint architecture is not applicable to the composed agent. The documented MoE backbone is described separately.
